name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-ninji
title: Super Mario World Styled Ninji
description:
One thing that always felt off about the Ninjis was their sprites. They were exactly the same from Super Mario Bros. 2 which clashes with the 16-bit environment of the game. Well, these set of custom graphics changes that! They are somewhat based on their 16-bit SMB2 appearance but you can change their color if you want.

These are my first pieces of custom graphic imports. However, I didn't make the graphics to begin with. There were made by MF230 on MFGG who made SMM styled graphics for them.
